en.html:
...Why?

Why had I been knocked down?

I did not understand.

I had caught Silver Star's breathing. Her intent... I thought I had understood it.

But no sign had come. Nothing. The attack arrived all at once and blew me away.

Why?

Had I got the whole thing wrong? All that distance, and I thought I was reading her breathing. Had it only been my grand imagination?

Or...

If that was not it.

Had knowing her intent been useless?

That enemy. That younger sister. That Demon King.

Had she already reached that place? The farthest state of a warrior's mind, taking up the sword without intent.

—Musouken.

en.html:
...My consciousness kept rising, sinking.

Dream... waking...

Which one was which? The distinction was going.

Muddied. Slipping away.

Defeat and death were coming. I knew.

But what of it now?

I had put everything into this fight. That had been the intention.

All my strength.

All my vows.

All my resolve.

Still not enough. Not even close. Completely beaten.

Then...

What more was I supposed to do?
